description: This is a shell script file for testing 'upload-pack ref-in-want' functionality in a Git server implementation. It contains test cases for various fetch scenarios, configuration checks, and repository setup, particularly for Git's protocol version 2 features, ref namespaces, and ref withholding. It also includes test setup for HTTP-based repositories, simulating server behavior and testing ref parsing and negotiation logic.

methods.name: get_actual_refs
methods.description: Extracts actual refs from 'out' using sed, unpacked through test-tool.

methods.name: get_actual_commits
methods.description: Unpacks commit data from 'out', verifies pack, sorts commit hashes.

methods.name: check_output
methods.description: Runs get_actual_refs and get_actual_commits, compares results with expected files.

methods.name: write_fetch_command
methods.description: Constructs and outputs a fetch command with optional ref specifications.

methods.name: inconsistency
methods.description: Simulates a server-side inconsistency where the ref reported initially differs from subsequent reports.
